trust_decision.summary: Which egress-auth parameters (the SASL/X509 params BSON, which can carry the password/digest) may be emitted as attributes in the detailed connection-health auth log lines; decided in the client auth code (authenticate.cpp, sasl_client_authenticate_impl.cpp). The fix drops the params attribute. At the pinned commit those log lines do not exist.

landing_point.why: The summary says sensitive data reaches mongod.log; the SASL client authenticate driver handles the params BSON that carries the password, and it is the main egress-auth code path. At the pin it has no LOGV2 of saslParameters (only debug payload logs at :212 and :220).
